title: Grateful Dead Live at Golden Hall - San Diego Community Concourse on 1970-08-05
venue: Golden Hall - San Diego Community Concourse

ai_review.summary: Hissy, primitive acoustic tape with a wonky drum mix and an unusual gospel‑flavored set that few fans have heard before.
ai_review.review: The recording captures a rare acoustic/ gospel set from the summer of ’70, but the tape is cloudy and hissy, and the right‑channel drum track on “Candyman” sounds completely out of sync – Mickey’s drumming is described as horrible. Reviewers are split: some appreciate the uncommon setlist, while most lament the primitive sound quality and odd drum mix.

ai_rating.rationale: Show is unique but not praised for performance; recording is generally judged poor to fair, pulling the overall rating toward average.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Tape is hissy and cloudy; right channel has a completely different drum track on “Candyman”, making the mix sound off. Reviewers suggest using EQ to improve playback.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Unusual acoustic gospel set that repeats a rare song list; reviewers note it’s not a common set for the Dead and feels more like a one‑off performance.

band_member_comments.Drums: Mickey's drumming on “Candyman” is criticized as horrible; right channel appears to have a different drum track.
